table_title: List the United States Supreme Court decisions that are identified as notable in their Chief Justice's per-Court Wikipedia article AND listed in the Wikipedia 'List of landmark court decisions in the United States' article, attributed to the Chief Justice of the per-Court source, with case year and primary issue area. Universe is the explicit intersection of the two source sets.
db_analog: SELECT pc.chief_justice AS justice, pc.case AS case, ml.year, ml.primary_issue FROM per_court_notable_cases pc JOIN landmark_court_decisions_master ml ON pc.case = ml.case_name ORDER BY ml.year ASC, pc.case ASC
temporal_note: Wikipedia per-Chief-Justice 'Court' articles (Jay Court through Roberts Court, 15 articles for the 15 chief justices whose per-Court 'Rulings of the Court' notable-cases lists intersect the master landmark article) and the Wikipedia 'List of landmark court decisions in the United States' article, all accessed 2026-04-30. The per-Court articles supply chief-justice attribution and SCOTUS-only filtering by editorial construction (each per-Court article covers exactly one Chief Justice's Supreme Court tenure). The master landmark article supplies year and primary issue values. The staged universe is the intersection: cases that appear in BOTH a per-Court 'Rulings of the Court' notable-cases list AND the master landmark article. This intersection is fully recoverable from the cited URL set without per-case verification or boundary-year decision-date lookups. 2 chief justices (Rutledge 1795, Ellsworth 1796-1800) have zero cases in the intersection because the master landmark article does not list cases from their tenures; this is honest to the source intersection, not curator filtering. The White Court source URL uses the disambiguated Wikipedia path 'White_Court_(justices)' to point at the SCOTUS article rather than the residential-estate article that 'White_Court' redirects to. Jay Court was excluded in cycles 1-5 and re-added in cycle-6 with Chisholm v. Georgia per the audit.
_extraction_notes: Implicit_join instance: per-Court notable cases ⋈ master landmark cases ON case-name equality. Universe = 115 cases that appear in BOTH a per-Chief-Justice 'Court' Wikipedia article's 'Rulings of the Court' (or equivalent 'notable cases') section AND the master 'List of landmark court decisions in the United States' Wikipedia article. The per-Court article supplies (Justice, Case) — chief-justice attribution is direct and SCOTUS-only by editorial construction. The master landmark article supplies (Year, Primary Issue) for each case. Per-CJ case counts (cycle-9): Jay 1, Marshall 9, Taney 1, Chase 3, Waite 7, Fuller 3, White 3, Taft 4, Hughes 3, Stone 6, Vinson 4, Warren 25, Burger 8, Rehnquist 7, Roberts 31. Total: 1+9+1+3+7+3+3+4+3+6+4+25+8+7+31 = 115 ✓. 2 chief justices (Rutledge, Ellsworth) have zero cases in the intersection. The audit-driven incremental expansion across cycles 1-9 (55 → 61 → 67 → 83 → 91 → 91 → 100 → 109 → 115 cases) reflects WebFetch truncation preventing fully exhaustive master article extraction in any single staging pass; the auditor has access to the full article and incrementally surfaces in-intersection cases. Cycle-9 fix (1 BLOCKING + 1 hygiene): (a) B1 (Roberts intersection still incomplete): added 6 audit-named Roberts Court cases — Burwell v. Hobby Lobby Stores, Inc. 2014 (Freedom of religion), Trump v. Hawaii 2018 (Executive power), Espinoza v. Montana Department of Revenue 2020 (Freedom of religion), Trump v. Mazars USA, LLP 2020 (Executive power), McGirt v. Oklahoma 2020 (Native American law), Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump 2026 (Executive power). Roberts count 25 → 31. Universe expanded 109 → 115 rows. (b) HYG: scrubbed source_urls[15] role-index fan-out bug from cycles 6-8 (all per-Court Roles block entries from index 3 onward had been mislabeled '[15]'); corrected '3 missing chief justices' → '2 missing'; updated 'cycle-2' source-plan wording to 'cycle-9'; updated SCOTUS-filter range '(source_urls[1-14])' → '(source_urls[1-15])'. The implicit_join shape is preserved: two distinct entity sets joined on case-name equality. Cycles 1+2+3 + Fields-Medal-cycles lessons applied throughout.
